question: Where is Mount Diavolo, an important mountain peak in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands, located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Middle Andaman**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mount Diavolo, an important mountain peak in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands, is located in Middle Andaman**__.
 
• **Mount Diavolo** is the highest point of Middle Andaman Island.
 __
 
• It has an elevation of 295 meters.
 
• Mount Diavolo (Mount Diavolo) is a mountain (class T - Hypsographic) in the Union Territory of Andaman and Nicobar Islands (Andaman and Nicobar Islands), India (Asia) with the region font code of Asia/Pacific.
 
• It is located at an elevation o**f 403 meters above sea level**.
 
• Its coordinates are 12°42'0" N and 92°55'0" E in DMS (Degrees Minutes Seconds) or 12.7 and 92.9167 (in decimal degrees). Its UTM position is DV90 and its Joint Operation Graphics reference is ND46-14.
 
• A Mountain is an elevation standing high above the surrounding area with a small summit area, steep slopes, and local relief of 300m or more.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Andaman Islands** are an Indian archipelago in the Bay of Bengal.

 
 
• These roughly 300 islands are known for their palm-lined, white-sand beaches, mangroves, and tropical rainforests.
 
• **Duncan passage** separates Little Andaman from South Andaman.
 
• The territory’s capital is the city of Port Blair.
 
• **THE BARREN AND NARCONDAM ISLANDS**, north of Port Blair, are volcanic islands [these are the only active volcanoes in India.
 
• **Saddle peak** (737 m) in North Andaman is the highest peak.
 
• State Animal of Andaman is the dugong (sea mammal) really endemic to Indo-Pacific seacoast areas, especially to the Andaman Islands.
